$comment: Every spell of Baldur's Gate 3 the game knows (made by scripts/bg3-spells.mjs from the BG3 wiki): its name, level (0: cantrip), school, whether it needs concentration, the classes that learn it (at the hero level their slots of its level open, src/data/spellbook.json casterKinds), knight: on the Eldritch Knight's list, the subclasses that learn it, book: its entry in src/data/spellbook.json (the D&D rules: range, dice, At Higher Levels), text: its in-game description, img: its icon under public/.
